content.short: BitTorrent enables decentralized peer-to-peer communication for file transfers.
content.description: BitTorrent is a decentralized peer-to-peer protocol for distributing data and large files, and its token is the BitTorrent Token (BTT). BitTorrent Speed is a token-enabled feature that uses BTT bidding to help prioritize data transfers, delivering faster download speeds and contributing to a healthier, more efficient protocol overall. By incentivizing peers with token rewards, the system aims to improve network performance while maintaining a decentralized approach to file sharing.
